depiction.primary_object: horizontal ticket stub with left notch and airplane inside
depiction.composition: single object, front view, outline ticket enclosing solid plane silhouette

readings.meaning: travel voucher or frequent flyer award

ambiguity: At very small sizes the notched rectangle can briefly resemble a memory card or SIM card, though the airplane inside clarifies it as a flight ticket.

reasoning: A notched ticket stub enclosing an airplane taking off unmistakably represents a flight ticket, boarding pass, or airfare booking. It fits a common, concrete family of personal and work travel tasks (booking flights, checking in, saving boarding passes, expensing airfare) and is easily distinguished from both plain airplanes and generic event tickets.
